model_interpretation.claim: The pricing for each input is independent and has a fixed-size 64-node initialization and rollback, so a static outer-loop partition should reduce the dominant large-call work without synchronization between elements. The dispatch limits workers to the supplied thread budget and requires at least 256 elements per worker, keeping small calls on a direct serial path and avoiding hardcoding the environment's thread count. Candidate performance remains unmeasured.

items.subject: Outer-loop CPU parallelism and thread-budget-aware dispatch
items.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, investigate parallelizing the independent per-element pricing work and dispatch using the supplied `threads` budget. Explore a low-overhead serial path for small workloads and suitable work partitioning without hardcoding the environment's 40-thread setting or changing global OpenMP controls. Preserve complete output overwrite and correctness for every entry. Compare whole-call timings across the official workload and available `n`/`threads` cases, including parallel overhead, and record failed scheduling or threshold variants.
